components.name: Settings navigation
components.description: Persistent navigation above scrolling settings content.
components.css: .ds-button{font:inherit;min-height:34px;border:1px solid var(--control-line);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 12px;line-height:1.35;cursor:pointer}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button:disabled{color:var(--muted);opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:12px}.ds-nav .ds-button{flex:1 1 auto;color:inherit;background:var(--surface)}.ds-nav .ds-button:hover{background:var(--soft)}.ds-nav [aria-current=page]{font-weight:600;outline:1px solid var(--line);outline-offset:-1px}.ds-nav .ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: The approved direction is a small dictation palette: microphone level, current status and main action form a vertically centered primary row. Transcript, recording details and advanced settings appear when needed. Preserve the existing macOS system font.
keyCharacteristics: OS titlebar names the app; content header contains only settings
dos: Do keep dictation primary and reveal supporting detail progressively.
Do preserve light/dark pairs and honor system contrast preferences.
Do keep errors, permission needs and keyboard focus visible.
donts: Don't present RMS bars as spectral analysis or animate invented telemetry.
Don't treat browser fixtures or screenshots as proof of native behavior.
